name: codex-codecollab
description: Capture each turn to your becos brain and recall relevant memory before every prompt.

interface.shortDescription: v0.6.2 · Session memory: capture + recall + backfill past sessions
interface.longDescription: On each user prompt, codecollab calls your becos brain (vonic_query) and injects relevant memory as additional context; on each turn it saves the prompt + assistant reply to the brain. Never sends reasoning, commands, or tool I/O.
defaultPrompt: Recall relevant context from my becos brain before answering my request.
